(3) The camera focuses on a woman in a purple jacket and blue face mask sitting on a metal bench in an airport waiting area; she looks directly at the camera with an expression of surprise as it zooms in on her. (4) A man wearing glasses and a grey sweater is positioned at a wooden counter, meticulously adjusting a small digital camera while looking at its screen. (5) A young woman in a beige hoodie walks through the airport arrivals gate pushing a grey suitcase and carrying a large brown bag; she has a huge smile on her face as she spots the group.
